payload.title: Underrated signal
payload.description:
Underrated marks signals rated high on Useful and Ready but with few mentions in the corpus: "Works better than it's talked about."

- Start from editor first-pass scores and the knowledge snapshot's per-entity item counts. Add reader means when they exist (5-rating floor).
- The rule and its threshold are publication data, stated on the policies page.
- Show a home panel, a signal-page mark and a Weekly line. There is no "overhyped" list.

Acceptance: the rule is documented, and the home panel lists only signals that meet it.
